rows.title: Repeated local authentication failures for one user
telemetry: journald via wazuh-logcollector (PAM, sudo, unix_chkpwd) on Linux agents
limitations: Each sudo attempt can emit 2 failure events (pam_unix + unix_chkpwd), so 6 events can be ~3 attempts.
Requires the srcuser field; failures decoded without it are not counted.
Spraying many users (one attempt each) does not trigger it.

rows.title: sudoers configuration changed
telemetry: Wazuh FIM on /etc/sudoers and /etc/sudoers.d (group linux agent.conf)
limitations: On WSL2, FIM runs in real-time mode without whodata, so the actor is not recorded.
Changes reverted between FIM events may be missed if the agent is offline.

rows.title: Scheduled task or systemd unit changed
limitations: User-level systemd units (~/.config/systemd/user) are not monitored.
No actor attribution on WSL2 (real-time mode).
Only the systemd path has a scenario (LNX-004); the cron path (T1053.003) is untested.

rows.title: Local account database changed
telemetry: Wazuh FIM on /etc/passwd, /etc/group, /etc/shadow, /etc/gshadow (no content diffs for shadow files)
limitations: Does not identify which account changed; review the passwd/group diff.
No actor attribution on WSL2 (real-time mode).
Depends on directory-level FIM of /etc; file-level watches are lost after atomic replaces (M2-LNX-002).
